predictions.rationale: Primary API endpoint exposing CRUD and query operations for catalog items, brands, and types—direct core implementation of the Catalog feature.
Entity Framework Core DbContext that models the catalog database tables for items, brands, types, and stock—foundational persistence layer for the Catalog feature.
Domain/entity class representing individual products in the catalog, including picture URI and stock information.
Seeds initial catalog data (items, brands, types, pictures) into the database—supports startup readiness of the Catalog.
gRPC service exposing catalog operations to other microservices—implements cross-service access to catalog data.
Web MVC client-side service that calls the Catalog API and assembles data for the storefront UI—directly supports displaying catalog items.
Configures database mapping for CatalogItem entity (table name, columns, relationships)—refines persistence details of the Catalog.
Controller dedicated to serving product pictures—supports the image aspect of the catalog items.
Entity class representing product brands, part of catalog taxonomy handled by the feature.
Entity class representing product types/categories within the catalog—essential data model component of the Catalog feature.
